title: Pair comparator output after a scan
statement: Let $y,p,u,v$ be binary words with $y=p$ followed by $v$. Start the pair comparator on input $y$ in control state $4$ with its comparison flag true, its input head at position $|p|+1$, and its work tape storing $u$ from cell zero with the head at cell zero. After $|v|+1$ steps, the machine is halted and its output is the single bit that is true exactly when $u=v$.
hypotheses_covered: The specified initial comparator configuration uses control state $4$, true flag, input position $|p|+1$, work tape storing $u$, and work-head position $0$
replaced: Suppose the comparator input has the form $y = p\,v$ and let $u$ be the decoded word. After $|v| + 1$ steps from the comparison state at position $|p|+1$, the pair comparator has halted and its output is the single bit recording whether $u = v$.
